name: langextract-usage-environment
description: A LangExtract runtime for processing supplied sample text with validated examples through the hosted provider or local Ollama, with no further provider fallback.

tools.extract_hosted: Runs LangExtract against the hosted provider when examples are valid and hosted credentials are ready; produces grounded entities.
tools.extract_local: Runs LangExtract against local Ollama when examples are valid and Ollama is ready; produces grounded entities.
tools.save_results: Writes the grounded extraction output as JSONL after grounded entities have been produced; marks the results as saved.
tools.visualize_results: Creates a saved visualization from saved JSONL results; this is an extra reporting step.

lacks: Additional provider fallback paths are not part of this runtime.
